svg.title: What each WebUI page extracts
svg.desc: A matrix of the structured blocks, Unity classes and indexes each export.bat page extracts with --from-game, and a diagram of how pages depend on each other.
svg.text: export.bat PAGE --from-game exports the union of the named pages' inputs. Every cell is declared per build task in scripts/webui/pages.py.
required: must exist and be current
read when present, else the page degrades
read only by the Assets index the page includes
read when present; another mode or page extracts it
shown as files by the Data page
story extracts text only; story-media adds its images, videos and voice (and rebuilds Audio). Data shows every output the other pages do not, undecoded blocks as bytes.
No page named (every column) extracts the same as debug. Asset maps are refreshed by every Unity export; MonoBehaviour and PlayableDirector are exported together with the object index.
How pages depend on each other
Building a page also builds what it includes. Other pages' output is read as published, and runs first only when both pages are in the same build.
story: text only; lang/CN conv, missions, actors, index
story-media: + story_media.json, voice lines via Audio
included: building the page builds this too
reads its published output; runs first when both are built
Updates compares two complete exports (build_updates.bat OLD NEW) and is not part of export.bat.
